description:
HermiT is an OWL 2 reasoner that can determine whether an ontology is consistent, classify classes and properties, and realize individuals.
	HermiT was originally developed by Boris Motik, Birte Glimm, Rob Shearer, Giorgos Stoilos, and Ian Horrocks at the Department of Computer Science of the University of Oxford.
	This repository is maintained by the Protégé project to provide HermiT builds for current OWL API and Protégé releases.
	This package includes the JAutomata library (http://jautomata.sourceforge.net/) and builds it directly because that project is no longer actively maintained.
